rationale: The high-volume expansion candle that triggered entry has not produced follow-through; price has stalled at 86.72 in the lower third of the daily range, the latest 1m candle contracted sharply on light volume, and the tape sits beneath VWAP while SPY drops 1.88% with VIXY up 12.3%. This combination of stalled demand and strong risk-off regime outweighs the brief lift above the 5m 9-EMA, making the long exposure no longer mechanically supported.
